name_de: Cube AMS Hybrid ONE44 C:68X TM 400X
name_en: Cube AMS Hybrid ONE44 C:68X TM 400X
description_de: Das Cube AMS Hybrid ONE44 C:68X TM 400X ist ein vollgefedertes E-Mountainbike von Cube. Der Antrieb (Bosch Performance SX) mit bis zu 60 Nm Drehmoment wird von einem 400-Wh-Akku gespeist. Federung: Fox 36 Float Performance GRIP, Tapered, 15x110mm, 140mm · Dämpfer Fox Float X Performance, 210x55mm, Adjustable LSR w/ 2-Pos. Lever. Schaltung: Sram GX Eagle AXS™ Transmission, 12-Speed, Electronic Shifting System. Bremsen: Sram Maven Silver, Hydr. Disc Brake (200/180). Rahmen: C:68X® Carbon. Erhältlich in den Größen S, M, L, XL.
description_en: The Cube AMS Hybrid ONE44 C:68X TM 400X is a full-suspension electric mountain bike from Cube. The drive (Bosch Performance SX) with up to 60 Nm of torque is powered by a 400 Wh battery. Suspension: Fox 36 Float Performance GRIP, Tapered, 15x110mm, 140mm · Dämpfer Fox Float X Performance, 210x55mm, Adjustable LSR w/ 2-Pos. Lever. Drivetrain: Sram GX Eagle AXS™ Transmission, 12-Speed, Electronic Shifting System. Brakes: Sram Maven Silver, Hydr. Disc Brake (200/180). Frame: C:68X® Carbon. Available in sizes S, M, L, XL.
